items: 【All-Weather Durability】Crafted with high-tensile PE rattan and a rust-resistant steel frame, this patio furniture set is built to withstand rain, sun, and humidity. It’s designed for long-lasting use in any outdoor environment

【Modular & Customizable Design】The 7-piece patio furniture set can be freely rearranged into an L-shape, U-shape, or any configuration you desire. This flexibility makes it ideal for patios, balconies, and any outdoor space

【Sturdy & Comfortable Seating】This outdoor sectional sofa set features a robust steel frame and thick, plush cushions for exceptional comfort and support. Anti-slip strips keep cushions in place, ensuring a stable and worry-free seating experience

【Versatile Outdoor Living】Whether you’re sunbathing, reading a book, or hosting a casual gathering, this patio conversation set elevates your outdoor experience. It’s the perfect centerpiece for relaxation and socializing
【Comfort & Easy Maintenance】The thick, plush cushions come with removable, machine-washable covers, making cleanup a breeze. Enjoy lasting comfort without the hassle of difficult maintenance
